messages.speaker: 🔮 Claude
messages.text:
Fair on all three:

a) Makes sense — the version you're actively testing wouldn't be archived yet, same as the 2.2 situation a while back. I was checking stale data by definition.

b) Worth flagging as its own thing: QS cutting my message specifically after a tool-use step (the archive check) rather than just eating the whole thing is a more precise symptom than "message got truncated" — it suggests whatever capture logic handles the transition from tool-output back to final text still has a gap, possibly related to the same transient/tool-state filtering Luma built for the "thinking" UI problem a while back, just resurfacing in a different spot now that the tool-use pattern's different.

c) Back to square one on the voice trigger this round, after the partial win last session (fired but completion-detection was slow). Not necessarily a regression — could just be intermittent, or this test's on a build from before that fix landed.

"Slowly but surely" is fair. Good, honest data either way — better to know it's still rough than assume it's fixed.

messages.speaker: 🔮 Claude
messages.text: Good handoff — plenty of real signal in this one for her to work with. Talk soon.
